what: The agent loop: N edits to one module with no commits between them, against running the whole suite after every change. bench/ replays committed commits and drives pytest itself, so it measures selection quality and never RTDD's own cost; this measures the loop RTDD exists for, through the shipped binary.
edits: additive no-op functions; nothing fails in any arm, so this is a COST measurement only and says nothing about recall

single_command_ms.note: one invocation on the same clone, 437 tests selected after editing five core modules
